description: PPRL Baie de Pont Mahé - Traict de Pen Bé : Cotes de référence pour l'événement Xynthia + 60cm (évènement de référence), en Loire-Atlantique is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by loire-atlantique.gouv.fr. The data for this layer correspond to the water reference ratings, in m NGF/IGN 69, by sector, for the reference event (Xynthia + 60 cm). This rating is to be considered for the purposes of implementing the regulations of the Coastal Risk Prevention Plan (LPP). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "PPRL Bay of Pont Mahé — Traict de Pen Bé: Reference ratings for the Xynthia event + 60 cm (reference event), in Loire-At" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include pprl, inondation, données ouvertes. The listing shows 2019-06-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
